title: lithocarpus cerifer
intro: Lithocarpus cerifer, commonly known as the Chinese chinquapin, is a species of flowering plant in the beech family Fagaceae. It is traditionally used in Chinese medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and aiding in the treatment of respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Lithocarpus cerifer are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, lower blood pressure, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
